description: Planned scan trajectories, driven one after another in the order of the trajectories table. Each trajectory is an orbit (circle or laminography) about a centre; its poses are the planned scan poses: the ROI frame (z towards the source, y up) with the source and detector frames, all in the scan's world frame. Poses generated from the orbit and poses moved by hand are both stored in full, so a reader needs no orbit generator.

application.description: What wrote the plan, e.g. RayBotic Viewer 0.1.1.

acquisition.description: Node path of a ct_acquisition recorded from this plan.

trajectories.description: One row per trajectory, in drive order; time = when the plan was written.

axis.description: Rotation axis (laminography: plate normal), unit vector.

start_direction.description: Direction from the centre towards the source at angle 0 (projected normal to axis).

tilt.description: Central beam against the plane normal to axis; 0 for a circle.

projections.description: Poses the orbit was generated with.

first_pose.description: Row of its first pose in poses.

pose_count.description: Rows in poses that belong to it.

poses.description: One row per planned pose, trajectory after trajectory; time = when the plan was written.

manual.description: Moved by hand: not on the orbit at its angle.

roi_rotation.description: Unit quaternion x, y, z, w.

source_rotation.description: Unit quaternion x, y, z, w.

detector_rotation.description: Unit quaternion x, y, z, w.
